craft_notes: Sthāyin: adhikāra-split — two tracks, one crown. Rows: catalogue kept whole; crown lands last. Rejected: dropping naimittika detail — killed: the bind on the mumukṣu is the point. Read aloud: long roll, firm close.

lines: Who seeks powers keeps second, fourth, and fifth entire;
for whom release is chief, the sixth leads — yet on feast-days he keeps the rest as he may, to crown the rite.
l4.sanskrit_cite: siddhikāmasya dvitīyaturyapañcamāḥ sarvathā nirvartyāḥ ṣaṣṭhas tu mumukṣoḥ mukhyaḥ tasyāpi dvitīyādyā naimittike yathāsambhavam anuṣṭheyā eva vidhipūraṇārthaṃ ca
